title: Dentelle Oval
subtitle: An oval diamond's facet pattern is the round brilliant stretched — same fire, longer light path. The Dentelle setting was designed so the prongs that hold it read as lace arches connecting stone to stone rather than mechanical grips on the center. The metalwork exists in service of the optical quality of the oval: it decorates rather than competes.
